name: Immich Machine Learning
short_desc: Standalone Immich ML backend (face recognition, smart search) for an external Immich server
author: immich-app
description: Runs Immich's machine-learning service on its own, so a separate Immich instance (e.g. on a NAS) can offload face recognition and CLIP smart search to a beefier host instead of running that workload on the NAS itself. Point the NAS's Immich Administration > Settings > Machine Learning > URL at `http://<this-host>:3003`. CPU build (image tag without `-cuda`): 4 workers, 300s worker timeout, 10 inter/intra-op threads.
